scoring.root_cause_accuracy: diagnosed category == scenario root_cause_category (domain aliases accepted, see CATEGORY_ALIASES)
scoring.evidence_recall: share of the scenario's expected_evidence keywords present in collected evidence
scoring.evidence_utilisation: share of collected evidence the final diagnosis actually cites
scoring.tool_selection_accuracy: every tool family the fault requires was actually called
scoring.recovery_success_rate: a recovery action succeeded AND the live environment passes the scenario's own criteria
scoring.verification_accuracy: the Agent's own verdict agrees with the environment's ground-truth evaluation
scoring.false_diagnosis_rate: a CONFIRMED/PROBABLE diagnosis that was wrong (abstentions are not counted)
scoring.escalation_rate: run handed over to a human instead of resolving
